component.name: AccountSessionTask
component.script:
sub init() m.top.functionName = "runAccountSession" end sub
sub runAccountSession() m.top.state = "loading"
mode = m.top.mode if mode = invalid or mode = "" then mode = "features"
if mode = "login" doLogin() else if mode = "refresh" doRefresh() else doFeatures() end if end sub
sub doLogin() apiBase = NormalizeApiBaseUrl(m.top.apiBaseUrl) if apiBase = "" then apiBase = GetDefaultApiBaseUrl()
email = LCase(TrimString(m.top.email)) password = m.top.password if password = invalid then password = ""
if email = "" or password = "" fail("Enter your StreamShōgun email and password.") return end if
result = ApiPostJson(apiBase, "/v1/auth/login", { email: email, password: password }, "") if not result.ok fail("Sign in failed. " + result.error) return end if
payload = result.json if payload = invalid or payload.accessToken = invalid or payload.refreshToken = invalid fail("Sign in response was missing account tokens.") return end if
session = LoadAccountSession() session.apiBaseUrl = apiBase session.email = email session.accessToken = payload.accessToken session.refreshToken = payload.refreshToken
if payload.subscription <> invalid applySubscriptionToSession(session, payload.subscription) end if
finishWithFeatures(session) end sub
sub doRefresh() session = LoadAccountSession() if m.top.apiBaseUrl <> invalid and m.top.apiBaseUrl <> "" session.apiBaseUrl = NormalizeApiBaseUrl(m.top.apiBaseUrl) end if
if session.refreshToken = invalid or session.refreshToken = "" fail("No saved account session. Sign in first.") return end if
result = ApiPostJson(session.apiBaseUrl, "/v1/auth/refresh", { refreshToken: session.refreshToken }, "") if not result.ok fail("Account refresh failed. " + result.error) return end if
payload = result.json if payload = invalid or payload.accessToken = invalid or payload.refreshToken = invalid fail("Refresh response was missing account tokens.") return end if
session.accessToken = payload.accessToken session.refreshToken = payload.refreshToken finishWithFeatures(session) end sub
sub doFeatures() session = LoadAccountSession() if session.accessToken = invalid or session.accessToken = "" fail("No saved account session. Sign in first.") return end if
finishWithFeatures(session) end sub
sub finishWithFeatures(session as Object) features = ApiGetJson(session.apiBaseUrl, "/v1/features", session.accessToken) if not features.ok fail("Could not check Pro features. " + features.error) return end if
payload = features.json if payload = invalid fail("Feature response was not valid JSON.") return end if
session.plan = IIF(payload.plan <> invalid, payload.plan, "FREE") session.status = IIF(payload.subscriptionStatus <> invalid, payload.subscriptionStatus, "ACTIVE") session.billingInterval = IIF(payload.billingInterval <> invalid, payload.billingInterval, "") session.currentPeriodEnd = IIF(payload.currentPeriodEnd <> invalid, payload.currentPeriodEnd, "") session.flags = IIF(payload.flags <> invalid, payload.flags, {}) session.flags["epg_proxy"] = (session.plan = "PRO" and (session.status = "ACTIVE" or session.status = "TRIALING")) session.checkedAt = CreateObject("roDateTime").AsSeconds()
SaveAccountSession(session) m.top.session = session m.top.state = "done" end sub
sub applySubscriptionToSession(session as Object, subscription as Object) session.plan = IIF(subscription.plan <> invalid, subscription.plan, "FREE") session.status = IIF(subscription.status <> invalid, subscription.status, "ACTIVE") session.billingInterval = IIF(subscription.billingInterval <> invalid, subscription.billingInterval, "") session.currentPeriodEnd = IIF(subscription.currentPeriodEnd <> invalid, subscription.currentPeriodEnd, "") end sub
sub fail(message as String) m.top.error = message m.top.state = "error" end sub
